title: Delta Declares War on Heathrow, American's Ebola Paperwork Problem, and Southwest Admits the Quiet Part Out Loud
summary: Delta's CEO is threatening to sue Heathrow Airport over a terminal shuffle that breaks up their cozy setup with Virgin Atlantic — and he's not being quiet about it. Plus, American flight attendants get a new Ebola attestation requirement with a scary catch, Southwest finally admits what "low-cost loyalty" actually meant, and a tennis star's bags make it to the gate without her.
